scope: Proposition 6.4 (Nefness of the canonical class) of the manuscript “Canonical ampleness of compact hyperbolic Kähler manifolds” (preprints/Canonical-ampleness-of-compact-hyperbolic-Kahler-manifolds-September-23-2026/canonical-ampleness.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 051 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 146466e3aa616985), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every ε > 0 there is a smooth real-valued function uε on X such that −Rk + i∂ ¯ ∂uε ≥ −εk. Consequently 2πc1(KX) is nef.
